hebrewText: וְ/עָבְד֤וּ אֹת/וֹ֙ כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/אֶת בְּנ֖/וֹ וְ/אֶֽת בֶּן בְּנ֑/וֹ עַ֣ד בֹּא עֵ֤ת אַרְצ/וֹ֙ גַּם ה֔וּא וְ/עָ֤בְדוּ ב/וֹ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וּ/מְלָכִ֖ים גְּדֹלִֽים

tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.

tokens.bdb: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and

tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
